summary: Add an unwired iOS sidebar membership paging model and feed conversion contract with bounded restarts and stale last-complete retention.

replay.detail: The model accepts restored bases only through its explicit testable input; no active storage or replay path changes.

schema.detail: No database or generated wire schema change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or coordination rule change.

compatibility.detail: Unwired code only; the active iOS sidebar remains v1. Future activation requires explicit daemon collection epochs and frontiers.

downtime.detail: No service restart or interruption required.

recovery.detail: Revert the unwired model, conversions and tests; no stored state requires recovery.
